name: Spiked Walls
disable: Thievery (trained) to snip the trip wire or jam the panel

items.name: Spiked Wall
items.text:
Trigger A creature triggers the trip wire

---
Effect A lattice panel lashed with wooden spikes swings shut across the passage. The triggering creature takes 3d6 piercing damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save save). The panel provides lesser Cover and prevents movement along the passage. The panel can be pushed open like a door with an Interact action, but it swings shut again unless wedged open with a heavy object.

text: A low trip wire connects to a lattice panel covered with wooden spikes.
